# Things in this repo

Things are managed by the `examplehost` package. Validate with `{cli} validate`.

The three commands whose argument names a declaration, so the scanner has one of
each to resolve: `{cli} skill add`, `{cli} rule examplehost`, and
`{cli} agent example-reviewer`. List them with `{cli} skill --list`.

A command of the host's own, named with a real argument rather than a
placeholder: `{cli} close fix-typo`.
